headline: Ghana export earnings hit record $30.4 billion through October on gold rally
summary: Ghana's total export earnings reached a record $30.4 billion in the first ten months of 2026, driven primarily by gold shipments, according to Bank of Ghana data.
why: Ghana is Africa's leading gold producer, and elevated bullion receipts provide essential foreign exchange support to its sovereign balance of payments.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Record export revenues strengthen Ghana's external accounts and trade balance.
